rationale: Eligible resident semilocal XC with admitted local AO maps defaults to an exact spatial permutation. Large strict-FP64 RKS owners with at least four AO jets, 512 AOs and 524288 points automatically use tile-aligned bisection on compute-capability 8+ low-FP64-throughput devices. Pure GGA and meta-GGA qualify; global hybrids require at least four work jets. Final-source selector-unset RTX5090 complete E/F cohorts qualify DF r2SCAN-3c, PBE and M06-2X with repeated cold/three-warm calls, independent default-grid and resource/graph/moved-geometry/memcheck checks. Unqualified domains retain center grouping. Explicit 1 restores center grouping, 2 requests bounded bisection and 0 retains canonical execution. Canonical force ownership and optional capacity/OOM fallbacks remain unchanged; full-rate FP64, mixed precision, fewer-work-jet or range-separated hybrids, UKS, nonlocal and explicit reference/public resource promises are not newly promoted.
revisit_condition: Require renewed complete-endpoint, independent observable, canonical force identity and resource/lifetime qualification before broadening the bisection domain or changing quadrature, AO thresholds or precision. Preserve the explicit center/canonical rollback and bounded optional-storage refusal.
